div.div:
PtpConfigs
• test-wpc-tbc — worker3: ens7f0 (receiver / tbc-tr) + ens7f1 & ens7f2 (transmitters / tbc-tt) + ts2phc / E810
• test-grandmaster — worker, ens1f0 (local GM on receiver LAN)
Requirements
• T-BC: WPC NIC with ≥3 ports (1 rx + 2 tx)
• Local GM: different node, same LAN as receiver; WPC+GNSS
• EXTERNAL_GM=true → TBCExtGM (no local GM)
Not in netdevsim CI
No WPC/GNSS; CI NICs also lack a true 3-port WPC. Diagram is role placement only.
ptpcimno lab
CUT cnfdf31 NIC4; GM cnfdf32 NIC6; needs L7 WPC↔WPC.
